intro: Bengaluru gives a home tutor ten zones to think about, and they behave very differently. The south-east office belt of Koramangala, HSR and Bellandur, and the eastern tech belt out to Whitefield, are mostly gated apartment communities where a security desk logs every visitor. Jayanagar, Basavanagudi, Malleshwaram and the old Cantonment streets are largely independent houses where you simply ring the bell. The metro now shapes travel: the Green, Purple and Yellow lines reach many layouts, but Hennur, Hebbal, Bannerghatta Road and Frazer Town still wait for open stations, so tutors there come by road. Choose the zones you can reach on a weekday afternoon, not just the ones that look close on a map.

Families here sit four kinds of examination. The Karnataka School Examination and Assessment Board, KSEAB, conducts the SSLC at the end of Class 10 and the II PUC examination at the end of Class 12, and its site lists notices for SSLC Exam-1 and Exam-2 along with subject blueprints, model question papers and question banks. PUC textbooks come in Kannada-medium and English-medium versions, so ask which one a student uses before the demo. Alongside the state board, families follow CBSE, CISCE's ICSE and ISC, and IB or Cambridge IGCSE. A tutor who knows one of these papers thoroughly is more useful to a family than one who lists all four.

Home and online work run side by side. When a family in, say, Kalyan Nagar sends a request, NXTutors shortlists two or three tutors: those living in the same area first, then the same zone, then elsewhere in Bengaluru, then online tutors. The family sees each tutor's fee before a free first demo and can switch tutor later without paying anything extra. If you live near a metro station, home visits along that line are realistic; if you live in Electronic City or Yelahanka, it may suit you to keep home lessons to your own zone and teach the rest of the city online. Either way, you set your own fee.

zone_notes.Koramangala, HSR & Bellandur: Bellandur and Sarjapur Road are mostly gated towers where the security desk registers every visitor, while Koramangala's inner blocks and HSR's sectors are doorstep visits once you have the block, sector, main and cross numbers. Crossing the Outer Ring Road at office opening or closing time makes weekday lessons hard to keep, so tutors on the same side of the ORR, or near Central Silk Board on the Yellow Line, are the natural fit.
zone_notes.Jayanagar, JP Nagar & Banashankari: This planned south is mostly independent houses in numbered blocks, stages and phases, so there is rarely a gate list and the house number with its cross and main road is all you need. The Green Line runs through Jayanagar, Banashankari and JP Nagar to Kanakapura Road, letting a tutor arrive by metro and walk, though the newer apartment projects further south do register visitors.
zone_notes.BTM, Bannerghatta Road & Electronic City: The Yellow Line, open since August 2025, links BTM Layout, Silk Board, Bommanahalli and Electronic City, so a tutor living a few stops away can cover the whole Hosur Road side. Electronic City's large apartment communities keep gate lists and office shift changes shape local traffic, and on Bannerghatta Road the Pink Line is not yet open, so travel there is by road.
zone_notes.Indiranagar & Old Airport Road: Indiranagar and the stretch towards Baiyappanahalli sit on the Purple Line, and Domlur has a bus terminus, so this compact eastern belt is workable without a vehicle. Start lessons before the evening crowd builds on 100 Feet Road, and expect to give your name at the gate in CV Raman Nagar's township and gated complexes.
zone_notes.Whitefield, Marathahalli & KR Puram: Homes here are mostly apartment towers and gated villa communities, and some security desks ask for photo ID on a first visit, so carry it. The Purple Line runs from KR Puram to Whitefield, but Marathahalli has no open station yet, so time weekday lessons between school and the office rush on the ORR and Whitefield Main Road.
zone_notes.Hennur, Kalyan Nagar & Banaswadi: No metro runs through this zone yet, so tutors who already live in Hennur, Kalyan Nagar, HRBR Layout or Banaswadi have the clearest advantage for regular weekday lessons. Kalyan Nagar and HRBR Layout are mostly houses and builder floors on numbered blocks, while Thanisandra's gated complexes need your name and phone number at the security desk.
zone_notes.Hebbal, RT Nagar & Yelahanka: Airport and office traffic funnels through the Hebbal flyover, so a tutor living on the family's side of it keeps evening slots far more reliably. Yelahanka New Town houses are doorstep visits and newer societies register visitors at the gate, and with the Blue Line stations still under construction nearly everyone arrives by road.
zone_notes.Malleshwaram, Rajajinagar & Yeshwanthpur: The Green Line links Malleshwaram, Rajajinagar, Mahalakshmi Layout and Yeshwanthpur, and most homes are houses or small buildings a short walk or auto ride from a station. Sadashivanagar's larger houses may have a guard at the gate and Yeshwanthpur's complexes keep registers, while Chord Road and Tumkur Road slow down at peak hours.
zone_notes.Vijayanagar, RR Nagar & Kengeri: The Purple Line runs west through Vijayanagar, RR Nagar and Kengeri, so a tutor anywhere along it can avoid Mysore Road at rush hour. Plotted layouts in Basaveshwaranagar and Nagarbhavi are houses with room for a two-wheeler, though some streets are steep, and apartment projects in RR Nagar and Kengeri keep a visitor list.
zone_notes.Frazer Town, Richmond Town & Ulsoor: Ulsoor and Richmond Town are a walk from Halasuru and Trinity stations on the Purple Line, but Frazer Town and Cooke Town have no open station, so plan an auto from the nearest one or come by road. Heritage bungalows share lanes with apartment buildings where a guard often stands at the entrance, and the shopping streets fill up in the evenings.

boards: In Bengaluru you will meet Karnataka state board students in SSLC and PUC, CBSE students, CISCE's ICSE and ISC candidates, and some IB and Cambridge IGCSE learners. For the state papers, read the subject blueprints, model question papers and notices on the KSEAB site, and the PUC textbooks and model papers on the Department of School Education (Pre-University) site. For CBSE, work from the sample papers and marking schemes on the CBSE academic site; for ICSE and ISC, the CISCE site. Teach the board you know well, and say so plainly on your profile.
faqs: How do tuition requests in Bengaluru reach me?

A family sends one request with the class, board, subjects, their layout or road and the times that suit them. NXTutors then shortlists two or three tutors, starting with those who live in that area, then the same zone, then elsewhere in Bengaluru, then online. If your profile fits, you are one of the tutors the family sees.
Can I teach online from Bengaluru, or must I travel?

Both are possible. You can keep home visits to the zone you live in, or to stops along one metro line, and teach students in the rest of the city, or anywhere in India, online. Online tutors appear after local ones in a family's shortlist for home tuition, so a clear online offer on your profile still matters.
Which areas of Bengaluru should I list on my profile?

List the layouts you can reach on a weekday evening, not every zone. A tutor in Jayanagar might cover JP Nagar and BTM by metro but not Whitefield, and one in Hebbal may stay north of the flyover. Accurate areas put you earlier in the shortlist for families close to you, which matters more than a long list.
What does the ID check involve?

Tutors who join go through an ID check: you confirm your phone or email with a one-time code and upload a government photo ID, which the team reviews before your profile goes live. Real tutors who pass carry a Verified badge. It is an identity check, not a background check, and the steps are set out at /how-we-verify-tutors.
What does it cost to be listed as a tutor?

The tutor plans, and what each of them includes, are listed on /pricing, so check the current options there. Separately, you set your own lesson fee, and families see it on your profile before the free first demo. Families can switch tutors later at no cost, so steady, well-prepared lessons are what keep a student with you.
